rows.original_comment: The finite-flat covering-family convention is not defined when that topology is introduced and contrasted with fppf.
rows.authors_claim: We defined a finite-flat cover as a jointly surjective family of finite flat morphisms, identified the corresponding affine ring maps as finite locally free, and stated the subcanonicity property used for the structure sheaf and descent. The finite-flat theorem remains logically separate from the fppf theorem.

rows.quality_assessment: The author claim is supported by B0016 and agrees with the R3 Phase 2A evidence commitment. No verdict adjustment is needed.

The conclusion retains the exact bound N>1, lists the non-formal proof inputs, and describes the four finite-algebra calculations only as the explicit computational core rather than the entire verification.
